node.title: F2 generated-field ambient invariance
node.statement: For F=F_(p^e), B=F_p(mu_n)=F_(p^k), and D=g mu_n, scaling S=gT gives p_j(S)=g^j p_j(T) and e_j(S)=g^j e_j(T). It therefore preserves t-null blocks, moment-trade block families, subgroup-coset structure, and complements exactly. For every F2 window and exponent set the syndrome maps satisfy A_D=diag(g^ell)A_B, so their F_p kernels, ranks, weighted ternary masses, subset-syndrome fibers, maxima, and collision sums are identical. Consequently the seven non-generating official degree/order types descend exactly to three of the five signed generating types. This does not restore ambient-normalized (O1) and proves no mass upper bound or final extras budget.
